CRITICAL (1)
  * aws_db_instance.app will be destroyed and recreated; the database and everything stored in it is lost [PLAN-DATA-002]
    The RDS database instance is replaced because storage_encrypted (false → true) cannot be changed in place. No final snapshot will be taken (skip_final_snapshot = true); deletion protection is off.
    -> If the change is intended, take a snapshot or backup first and plan the cutover. If the replacement is a surprise, revert storage_encrypted. lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true } makes Terraform refuse a plan like this.
